coordinates: x/z logical coordinates × 1.45; y already world units
texture: One selected 2048 atlas; clamp to edge, linear sampling, no mipmaps to prevent neighboring cell bleed
uv: Half texel inset inside 8px extruded padding. Per-face UVs are remapped to the selected tile inner rectangle.
collision: Simplified separate boxes. Hollow prefabs use individual support boxes; decoration has no gameplay collision.
ramps: Smooth rendered slope; collision step strips ≤0.15 high plus followRamp actor support hook.
navigation: Cached layered graph, ground heights in node.y/node.height. Rebuild links after destruction or dynamic geometry.
